title: Ouai partners with You actor Victoria Pedretti on horror-inspired content series
summary: Ouai has teamed up with American actress Victoria Pedretti, who starred in Netflix thriller You, for a new content series tapping into the world of horror films as ‘The Chopper’ sweeps the hair care brand’s office

extraction.key_fact: 헤어케어 브랜드 Ouai가 배우 Victoria Pedretti와 콘텐츠 시리즈를 만든다.
